title: Claude Code Project Manifest
description: Declares project metadata and selectively activates skills to optimize token usage. Place in project root as project.json.

project_type.description: Classification that determines default skills and agent routing. See orchestration.md for mappings.

auto_include.description: If true, include default skills for project_type + active_skills. If false, use ONLY active_skills (minimal token use).

active_skills.description: Explicitly declare which skills are available in this project. If auto_include=true, these are added to the default set. If auto_include=false, these are the ONLY skills loaded.

disabled_skills.description: Skills to EXCLUDE from the default set (only used if auto_include=true). Useful for removing less-relevant skills from a project type.

metadata.description: Optional project-wide constants and constraints (mirrors Artifacts/MEMORY_ANCHORS.md intent).
